headline: US futures trade mixed with Dow under pressure as earnings ramp up and durable goods and JOLTs data loom while oil steadies after Iran-linked volatility
raw_text:
- Oracle (ORCL) trades roughly flat pre-market after pricing a $10 billion stock offering and $10 billion in senior notes as part of a $20 billion capital-raising plan to fund its AI cloud infrastructure buildout
- Campbell’s Co (CPB) trades lower pre-market after an EPS miss, soft sales, and reduced full-year guidance
- Uber (UBER) slips pre-market on news of a robotaxi partnership with Amazon’s (AMZN) Zoox unit
- S&P 500 Futures (@ES) are down 0.20%, Dow Jones Futures (@YM) fall 0.66%, Nasdaq 100 Futures (@NQ) edge higher by 0.05%, and Russell 2000 Futures (@ER2) decline 0.22%
- Asian shares retreat overnight, with South Korean tech names under pressure ahead of US midterm elections
- European markets open lower in early trading following the weak tone in Asia
- Oil futures (@CL) gain as prices stabilize after recent volatility tied to developments in Iran
- A busy earnings slate features Shopify (SHOP), Pfizer (PFE), Eaton (ETN) and others reporting before the open, with AMD (AMD), Amgen (AMGN) and Arista Networks (ANET) due after the close
- Key US data releases include durable goods orders at 8:30 AM ET and JOLTs job openings at 10:00 AM ET, both seen as potential intraday volatility catalysts
- No major new catalysts have emerged since the 4 AM session start, according to the summary
